Title: 499757-2026: France – Construction work for buildings relating to health – GLOBAL PERFORMANCE CONTRACT FOR THE CONSTRUCTION, OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE OF THE NEW HOSPITAL OF PAYS SALONAIS
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: New hospital construction is a complex building project and therefore potentially of interest for sbp. Deduction because of the location in France (outside the DACH region) and because it is a global performance/DBFM contract with operation/maintenance, which has lower priority.
titel: Global performance contract for construction, operation and maintenance of the new Pays Salonais hospital
kurzbeschreibung: New construction of a hospital as a turnkey performance contract including operation and maintenance in France.
umfang: New construction of a hospital on the Gabins site in the southwest of Salon-de-Provence. It is a global performance contract for design, construction, operation and maintenance. Specific technical parameters such as gross floor area, number of beds, spans or building volume are not stated in the notice. Contract term 132 months, planned start 17.07.2028.
leistungen: Construction works for a healthcare building or hospital including associated design services, permitting documents, construction drawings and specifications as well as operation and maintenance under a global performance contract.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Large building project in the healthcare sector with substantial contract volume
• Early strategic entry possible via competitive dialogue and design components
• Hospital as a complex building is in principle relevant for sbp, even without explicit structural details
• Sustainability and performance focus in the procurement model increases strategic attractiveness
• However, the emphasis is on a global performance contract combining construction, operation and maintenance, not on a clearly defined structural design package
• No specific information on spans, special structures or architecturally exceptional structures, hence no higher rating
baukosten_erklaerung: Taken from the contract notice; an estimated contract value of 111200000 EUR excluding VAT is stated for the overall contract. However, this includes construction, operation and maintenance and therefore cannot be clearly allocated only to cost groups 300 and 400.
honorar_erklaerung: No explicit fee for structural design or sbp-relevant specialist design services stated. Due to the global performance contract with construction, operation and maintenance, a reliable derivation of an sbp fee from the notice alone is not realistically possible.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Eligibility criteria according to the procurement documents. The names and professional qualifications of the personnel assigned to perform the contract must be indicated in the tender. Two-phase procedure with selection of exactly 3 bidders for the second phase.
auftraggeber: HÔPITAL DU PAYS SALONAIS, 207 Av Julien Fabre, 13300 Salon-De-Provence, France; Contact: SABATIER Hélène; E-mail: correspondre@aws-france.com; Website: http://www.ch-salon.fr/; Buyer profile: http://marchespublics.ght13.fr/
notes: Competitive dialogue. Estimated total value 111200000 EUR excluding VAT. Options and possible award of similar services envisaged. Variants permitted. Minimum and maximum number of candidates to be invited to the second phase is 3. Tender or participation language French. The notice concerns a marche global de performance, i.e. an integrated contract for design, construction, operation and maintenance.
